title: The universal stuff is experiential creativity, an enlargement of energy

statements.text: All actual entities embody creativity, an enlargement of the notion of energy in current physics, so all can affect and be affected by the entities physics studies. Materialism takes the universal stuff to be vacuous energy, panexperientialism takes it to be experiential creativity.

sources.quote: all actual entities are embodiments of "creativity," which is an enlargement of the notion of energy as understood in current physics
In panexperientialist physicalism, by contrast, the universal stuff embodied in all individuals is not vacuous energy, but experiential creativity.
